title: Android MVP Builds
meta: A focused first version of your Android app, built fast so you can test your idea with real people. From $350, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Android MVP build to test your idea quickly
overview: We help you pick the one problem your first version must solve, cut the feature list to what it needs, and build a working Android app that real people can install. Testers join through a Play testing link. You receive the source code, a way to collect feedback and a short list of what to build next if the idea works.

pkgs.blurb: One core feature, working end to end and ready to test.
A testable product with accounts, cloud data and basic analytics.
A launch-ready first version with billing and Play submission.

faq: How is an MVP different from a full Android app?
An MVP does one job well enough to test demand. We build only the flow that proves your idea. If people use it, you can grow it with our feature work or app build services.
Can you help me trim my feature list?
Yes. We begin with a one-page scope that keeps the essentials. You approve it before coding starts, which keeps the build inside the delivery window and avoids surprise extras.
Can testers install the app without a public release?

Internal testing shares builds with a small group quickly. Closed testing needs a Play Console setup, and Google requires it for some newer developer accounts before release. We explain which applies to you.
No. It uses the same Kotlin and Compose structure as a full app, so you can keep building on it. Shortcuts we took, such as simple storage, are noted in the handover.
